@multiRename.mediaField.exifIso.sameAsSourceJustification: ISO is the standard name of the sensitivity setting; Czech camera menus and macOS Photos write ISO too (@key: keep ISO as is).

@multiRename.mediaField.tagAlbum.sameAsSourceJustification: Album is the Czech word too (macOS Hudba and music players label the field Album).
